## My statements from the public forum.
## I'm Karen Hardy, An Independent Candidate
For Mayor.
### I Care Deeply About this Community
In my 40+ years living here, I have worked to protect our quality of life and economic stability.
I am working regionally to protect our strained water resources and preserve the communication network between all public safety agencies. This is why I promise to continue to vote for the best city services possible.
I understand the problems that our teachers face and I promise to support them as mayor.
More About Me
# Less Talk, More Action -
Real Solutions for Santa Clara
My Plans for Santa Clara
The Services the city is charged with, should be the best we can offer! I will work on:
Making housing more affordable by approving a wider variety of housing units, including mixed-use zoning, for more housing and businesses.
Keeping utility fees down (we have the lowest electrical rates for a large supplier in California)
Improving, maintaining infrastructure - especially the water system.
Great City services -
Police & Fire
Water, Sewer, Electrical & road maintenance
Parks and recreation programs
​
My governance style is - engagement, transparency, and decency.
My personal belief is that EVERYONE is important, and every resident of Santa Clara has a voice worth hearing.
​
I have years of experience in local governance and community service, I understand the challenges our city faces, and I am committed to finding effective solutions to accomplish these goals.
​

### Endorsements
Titles are for Identification purposes only. Statements are made by individuals and do not imply organizational endorsement.
### Lorie Garcia
Santa Clara City Historian
Having known Karen Hardy for three decades, I have witnessed her deep commitment to both the preservation of Santa Clara’s unique historic resources and the responsibility to ensure its growth into a sustainable future, without ever losing track of what its citizens need to make their city the special placeit is. A vote for Karen Hardy for Mayor, is a vote for Santa Clara’s Past, Present and Future.
### John K. Haggerty
I gladly endorse Karen Hardy for Mayor of Santa Clara in the Fall 2026 City Election because during the past 35 years that I have known her Karen has provided our city with wise, successful, and compassionate leadership at every level and in every sphere of city life. As our Mayor, Karen will continue to pursue the best interests of our uniquely blessed city with excellence and love.
### Judy Nadler
Former Mayor, City of Santa Clara
Throughout my career in public service, I have worked to strengthen ethical leadership, transparency, and community involvement in local government. Karen Hardy has been a champion for these issues in her service to Santa Clara.
Karen’s service on the City Council, Planning Commission, Historical Commission, and regional water boards demonstrates a broad and thoughtful understanding of Santa Clara’s needs. Karen approaches public service with empathy, respect, and a commitment to ensuring that every resident feels heard.
As a teacher, founder of an internationally recognized robotics program, and in her community work, Karen shows a deep belief in opportunity, inclusion, and fairness.
Her leadership reflects values that matter to me ~integrity, responsibility, and a belief that good government should improve people’s lives. She brings both experience and heart to the work.
Santa Clara deserves a mayor who leads with ethics, compassion, and a strong sense of civic responsibility. I am proud to endorse Karen Hardy for Mayor.
### Leslie Ragsdale
BAWSCA Board Policy Chair and Hillsborough Vice Mayor
I have worked closely with Karen for the almost four years on the BAWSCA Board. She is extremely smart and works well with everyone. Karen is always well informed, thoroughly prepared and very collegial. I know she will make an outstanding mayor for Santa Clara and wholeheartedly endorse her campaign!
Titles do not imply organizational endorsement
